prompt:
Create exactly ONE NEW full-page desktop homepage for Pro League, the official public information portal for a local football federation, using the attached project design system. The previous plain calendar concepts were rejected. This must look like a compelling football brand and editorial homepage that fans want to explore, with powerful amateur-football photographs and storytelling, not an administrative dashboard.

PLATFORM: Web, desktop reference width 1440px. Produce an actual SCREEN artifact with screenshot and HTML, not only a description.

REFERENCE INTERPRETATION:
The owner's public-page references show a proud shield-and-ball wordmark, cinematic adult amateur football photography at sunset, stadium grass and community stands, large expressive headlines, crisp outlined sports-data panels, photo-led competition cards, and an editorial lead story. Recreate that visual language through the project's attached tokens, not a generic card-kit. No admin sidebar or admin profile. Do not access/reuse previous projects.

PAGE STRUCTURE:
1. Header: a simple original shield-and-football mark, Pro League wordmark, subtitle «Офіційний портал місцевого футболу». Navigation exactly «Головна», «Новини», «Змагання», «Календар», «Таблиці». No global season dropdown, search, account, notifications, language selector or subscriptions.
2. Photographic hero: wide cinematic image of a fictional adult amateur team celebrating together on a local football ground at golden hour, small community stands in the distance. Leave composition space for readable overlaid heading «Футбол, який об’єднує громади» and subtitle «Матчі, результати та історії місцевого футболу — в одному місці». Two actions: «Матчі туру» and «Новини громад». Hero must be emotionally compelling but not full-viewport: keep the beginning of match information visible in the first desktop viewport. No stats counters, fake visitor counts, LIVE or auto-advancing carousel.
3. Compact match centre directly below the hero. Heading «Матчі та результати», labeled competition selector initially «Усі змагання», tabs «Найближчі» selected and «Результати». Display exact freshness text from content. Show m7 and m8 with full team names, 31 жовтня 2026, 14:00 and 16:00 local Kyiv time; no score because scheduled. Separate unobtrusive schedule-change notice for m9 postponed, date/time unknown, and m10 cancelled, not upcoming. Results tab, if implemented, uses m5 2:0 and m6 1:2. No invented venues, referees, counts, protocol numbers or fictional live clocks. Internal IDs must never be visible.
4. Editorial content / standings split: a large lead photo story featuring article n1 «Третій тур завершено: «Обрій» зберігає перше місце». Its adult celebration image is explicitly illustrative, not a real match photo. Label this lead block «Головна історія». Follow with n3 and n2 as the latest two article teasers ordered newest first. Preserve exact supplied titles, categories, dates and summaries. Use meaningful football/field photography rather than empty icon rectangles. Nearby compact standings panel: title «Попередня турнірна таблиця», explicit «Чемпіонат Приозерського краю / 2026/27 / Ліговий етап». Four exact rows from shared data, columns Місце, Команда, І, В, Н, П, М’ячі, О. Numeric cells aligned; link «Повна таблиця». No invented zones or team-form stats.
5. «Змагання федерації»: three genuinely photographic competition cards with distinct visual motifs: adult match action for championship; a neutral trophy on a grass field for cup; a community football ground for the preparing competition. Use the exact three competition names, seasons and presentation statuses in the shared content. Each card has «Переглянути змагання». Cup has no league table; preparing competition has no published matches. No registration button, new formats or invented participant counts.
6. A concise federation/community identity section using the supplied federation description, followed by the fictional email and supplied contact warning. No invented history, sponsors, medals or organizational claims.
7. Footer with the same five public navigation links and © 2026 fictional federation name.

CONTENT / ASSETS:
Use readable Ukrainian and full long team names, no unexplained abbreviations. All sporting data are synthetic and supplied below, not official records. Put a visible but visually restrained «Демонстраційний макет» notice and a footer disclosure «Зображення ілюстративні; дані вигадані».
For the photos, generate fictional illustrative adult-amateur-football imagery if supported by Stitch. No real brands, known players, children or copied club badges. Do not fetch arbitrary stock photos and claim a license. If source rights are not verifiable, keep any such images explicitly draft-only and surface this limitation. Do not use the supplied screenshots as literal background images.
Use the project's visual system without reinterpreting it as a SaaS dashboard. Normal text must remain legible, status must not rely on color alone, and photographs need readable text treatment. No additional screens, match modal, mobile page or admin interface.
The supplied media=neutral-placeholder values are historical from V1: the owner explicitly approved replacing these with photographic illustration for homepage. Do not carry over V1's placeholder-only styling.
